hunks.baseline: By the time we left the underground bunker, it was already deep into the night.
hunks.sol: By the time we emerged from the underground bunker, it was already deep into the night.

hunks.baseline: I drew in a deep breath, and the cold air seeped into my lungs. As I gazed up at the star-filled night sky, thinking of the Sichuan of the Murim somewhere out there, a small hand tapped me on the shoulder.
hunks.sol: I drew a deep breath, letting the cold air seep into my lungs. As I gazed up at the star-studded sky and thought of Murim’s Sichuan, somewhere out there, a small hand tapped me on the shoulder.

hunks.baseline: “Want to come along? I was thinking of having a light drink.”
hunks.sol: “Want to come along? I was thinking of having a quick drink.”

hunks.baseline: It was Pai Chen. Two people who belonged to her “us” stood behind her.
hunks.sol: It was Pai Chen. Behind her stood the other two people included in that “us.”

hunks.baseline: One of them spoke in a voice overflowing with dignity.
hunks.sol: One of them spoke with overflowing dignity.

hunks.baseline: “I’m not a noblewoman, but of course there is. Do you like wine, Prince?”
hunks.sol: “I’m no noblewoman, but of course there is. Do you like wine, Prince?”

hunks.baseline: Prince Felix answered with an displeased expression.
hunks.sol: Prince Felix answered with a displeased expression.

hunks.baseline: “I told you to call me His Highness Felix, not Prince. And I enjoy wine in moderation. Especially forty-five-year-old Romanée-Conti.”
hunks.sol: “I told you to call me Your Highness Felix, not Prince. And I enjoy wine in moderation—especially 1945 Romanée-Conti.”

hunks.baseline: “We don’t have any forty-five-year-old.”
hunks.sol: “We don’t have the 1945 vintage.”

hunks.baseline: “Then I must decline. I’ll be going.”
hunks.sol: “Then I must decline. Farewell.”

hunks.baseline: As Prince Felix disappeared with his attendants, Pai Chen turned toward the one person left.
hunks.sol: Prince Felix disappeared with his attendants, and Pai Chen turned to the one person left.

hunks.baseline: Magic Johnson smiled, baring his perfectly white teeth.
hunks.sol: Magic Johnson smiled, baring his gleaming white teeth.

hunks.baseline: “I’m sorry. Unfortunately, I think I’ll have to take a rain check.”
hunks.sol: “My apologies. Unfortunately, I think I’ll have to take a rain check.”

hunks.baseline: “I might be deployed to the front tomorrow. I should at least use *Memorize* so I can put my mind at ease.”
hunks.sol: “I might be deployed to the front as early as tomorrow. I’d feel better if I at least prepared *Memorize* beforehand.”

hunks.baseline: Deeply impressed by Magic Johnson’s attitude, I opened my mouth.
hunks.sol: Deeply impressed by Magic Johnson’s attitude, I spoke up.

hunks.baseline: Unbelievable. Setting aside the ridiculous stubbornness she was displaying, that middle-aged woman was really something for suggesting drinks in a situation like this.
hunks.sol: Unbelievable. Her ridiculous stubbornness was one thing, but this middle-aged woman was really something, suggesting drinks at a time like this.

hunks.baseline: “You just insulted me in your head, didn’t you? You called me a clueless middle-aged woman for thinking about drinking in a situation like this.”
hunks.sol: “You just insulted me in your head, didn’t you? Called me a thoughtless middle-aged woman for wanting a drink in a situation like this.”

hunks.baseline: “...How did you know?”
hunks.sol: “…How did you know?”

hunks.baseline: “Oh my, look how pointlessly honest you are.”
hunks.sol: “Oh my. Look how pointlessly honest you are.”

hunks.baseline: Pai Chen poked the tip of my nose with one long finger. She looked like a beautiful woman in her early twenties, but in reality, she was older than my mother. It gave me a strange feeling.
hunks.sol: Pai Chen poked the tip of my nose with one long finger. She looked like a beautiful woman in her early twenties, but she was actually older than my mother. It felt strange.

hunks.baseline: Pai Chen tilted her head slightly. Lee Jungryong had disappeared a long time ago with the Ares Guild members he had brought along.
hunks.sol: Pai Chen tilted her head slightly. Lee Jungryong had long since disappeared with the Ares Guild members he had brought along.

hunks.baseline: “Hmm. He’s a difficult man. He wasn’t like that during the Great Cataclysm, but he’s become a slippery old fox. You can’t tell what he’s thinking.”
hunks.sol: “Hmm. He’s difficult to deal with. He wasn’t that bad during the Great Cataclysm, but he’s turned into a slippery old fox. I can never tell what he’s thinking.”

hunks.baseline: *She’s a pretty accurate judge of character.*
hunks.sol: *She’s a pretty good judge of character.*

hunks.baseline: “Wu Heixing. He’s too rude. Drinking with him would ruin the taste.”
hunks.sol: “Wu Heixing. He’s too rude. Drinking with him would ruin the wine.”

hunks.baseline: I stared at Wu Heixing’s back as he headed toward a deserted forest and answered.
hunks.sol: I watched Wu Heixing’s back as he headed into a deserted forest and answered.

hunks.baseline: “Nothing we can do. You’ll have to drink next time.”
hunks.sol: “Nothing you can do, then. You’ll have to drink some other time.”

hunks.baseline: “No. This is exactly when you’re supposed to drink.”
hunks.sol: “No. This is exactly the sort of night you drink on.”

hunks.baseline: “It might be the last chance we get.”
hunks.sol: “It might be our last chance.”

hunks.baseline: War exhausted people. At the same time, it brought unexpected farewells in the form of death.
hunks.sol: War exhausted people. It also brought unexpected farewells in the form of death.

hunks.baseline: It was her own sort of prewar celebration after losing countless companions during the Great Cataclysm.
hunks.sol: This was her own eve-of-battle ritual after losing countless companions during the Great Cataclysm.

hunks.baseline: Once this crisis was over, one of us might have crossed the river from which no one returned.
hunks.sol: By the time this crisis was over, one of us might have crossed the river of no return.

hunks.baseline: “Well, now that things have turned out this way, I have no choice but to change targets. Don’t you agree, handsome bachelor over there?”
hunks.sol: “Well, now that things have turned out this way, I have no choice but to change targets. Don’t you agree, handsome young man over there?”

hunks.baseline: “Do you have no conscience? I’m talking about that young man, not you.”
hunks.sol: “Have you no shame? I meant that young man, not you.”

hunks.baseline: The handsome bachelor Pai Chen had singled out, Team Leader Choi, nodded readily—contrary to my expectations.
hunks.sol: Contrary to my expectations, the handsome young man Pai Chen had singled out—Team Leader Choi—nodded readily.

hunks.baseline: “I should. When will I get another chance to have a drink with Pai Chen? And I have a lot of questions.”
hunks.sol: “Of course. When will I ever get another chance to have a drink with Pai Chen? Besides, I have plenty of questions.”

hunks.baseline: “I thought you were only handsome, but you say such pretty things, too. All right, then. What are you so curious about?”
hunks.sol: “I thought you were only handsome, but you have a way with words too. All right, then. What are you so curious about?”

hunks.baseline: “For the Equipment you’re wearing right now. Where did you buy it?”
hunks.sol: “The Equipment you’re wearing right now. Where did you buy it?”

hunks.baseline: “...That’s your question?”
hunks.sol: “…That’s your question?”

hunks.baseline: “This one’s quite a handful too.”
hunks.sol: “You’re quite a handful too.”

hunks.baseline: As Pai Chen let out a deep sigh, Magic Johnson broke into a hearty laugh.
hunks.sol: Pai Chen let out a deep sigh, and Magic Johnson burst into hearty laughter.

hunks.baseline: “Haha. Miss Chen, shall we all go have a drink now?”
hunks.sol: “Haha! Miss Chen, shall we all go have that drink now?”

hunks.baseline: “I did. I don’t make a habit of drinking alone with women. But if a charming man like Mr. Choi joins us, that changes things.”
hunks.sol: “I did. I have no interest in drinking alone with a woman. But if a charming man like Mr. Choi will be joining us, that changes things.”

hunks.baseline: “Y-yes. Let’s go.”
hunks.sol: “R-right. Let’s go.”

hunks.baseline: No wonder Time had named him the world’s most influential LGBTQ person.
hunks.sol: No wonder *Time* had named him the world’s most influential LGBTQ person.

hunks.baseline: I sent Sound Transmission to Team Leader Choi as he was dragged away, stiff as a board.
hunks.sol: I sent Team Leader Choi a Sound Transmission as he was dragged away, stiff as a board.

hunks.baseline: —If anything happens, contact me.
hunks.sol: —Contact me if anything happens.

hunks.baseline: Team Leader Choi looked at me with the sad eyes of an ox being led to slaughter, then disappeared with the two S-rank Hunters. I looked around before setting off.
hunks.sol: Team Leader Choi looked back at me with the mournful eyes of an ox being led to slaughter, then disappeared with the two S-rank Hunters. After glancing around, I set off.

hunks.baseline: How long had I walked along the dark path to avoid people’s eyes? I stopped in the pitch-black darkness and spoke.
hunks.sol: I walked along the dark path, keeping out of sight. After some time, I stopped in the pitch-black forest and spoke.

hunks.baseline: After a brief silence, someone’s voice drifted out.
hunks.sol: After a brief silence, someone’s voice drifted from the darkness.

hunks.baseline: “...Not bad.”
hunks.sol: “…Not bad.”

hunks.baseline: A figure emerged with the sound of someone approaching. Wu Heixing looked me up and down.
hunks.sol: A figure emerged with the sound. Wu Heixing looked me up and down.

hunks.baseline: I answered listlessly.
hunks.sol: I answered flatly.

hunks.baseline: “Don’t pretend to compliment me now. It’s obvious you’re trying to pull some kind of cheap trick.”
hunks.sol: “Don’t pretend to compliment me now. It’s obvious you’re trying to pull some cheap trick.”

hunks.baseline: I had hit the mark. Wu Heixing’s face flushed red.
hunks.sol: Bull’s-eye. Wu Heixing’s face flushed red.

hunks.baseline: In a way, he was incredibly easy to handle. I believed he was already in his mid-thirties, yet it was hard to imagine anyone being this simple.
hunks.sol: In a way, he was incredibly easy to handle. He had to be well into his mid-thirties, yet it was hard to imagine anyone being this simple.

hunks.baseline: “You probably do sincerely think I’m a *bangzi*.[^1] You were annoyed because some Korean guy who isn’t even an official S-rank Hunter yet was getting attention instead of you. You picked a fight with your usual one-dimensional behavior, but it didn’t go over well, and that *bangzi* bastard turned out to be tougher than you expected, huh?”
hunks.sol: “You probably do sincerely think I’m a *bangzi*.[^1] Some random Korean who isn’t even officially an S-rank Hunter yet was getting all the attention instead of you, so naturally you got pissed off. You picked a fight in your usual one-dimensional way, but no one reacted the way you wanted, and that *bangzi* bastard turned out to be tougher than expected. That about right?”

hunks.baseline: I continued speaking like a machine gun without giving him a chance to respond.
hunks.sol: Without giving him a chance to answer, I continued at machine-gun speed.

hunks.baseline: “So you threw out a few compliments you didn’t mean and started acting friendly while looking for an angle… Am I wrong about anything I’ve said so far?”
hunks.sol: “So now you’re throwing out a few compliments you don’t mean and acting friendly while you look for an angle… Did I get any of that wrong?”

hunks.baseline: “Yeah, I’ve seen plenty of people like you. After getting hit in the back of the head so many times, even my brain—which had stopped working—started spinning again.”
hunks.sol: “Yeah, I’ve seen plenty of guys like you. Take enough hits to the back of the head and even a slow brain like mine learns to work fast.”

hunks.baseline: I looked at him with pity. His face already bright red, Wu Heixing stammered.
hunks.sol: I gave him a contemptuous look. His face already bright red, Wu Heixing stammered out a reply.

hunks.baseline: “I wasn’t trying to pull any other kind of trick.”
hunks.sol: “I wasn’t trying to pull another trick.”

hunks.baseline: “Then what? If you’re thinking of becoming friends with me, fold that thought up neatly and tuck it away. If I stand next to shit, the stink rubs off on me too.”
hunks.sol: “Then what? If you were thinking of becoming friends with me, fold that idea up neatly and put it away. Stand next to shit and the stink rubs off on you.”

hunks.baseline: “By the way, what are you doing right now?”
hunks.sol: “By the way, what are you doing?”

hunks.baseline: Wu Heixing looked at me with hesitation in his eyes before blurting out,
hunks.sol: Wu Heixing stared at me, visibly conflicted, before blurting out,

hunks.baseline: I looked directly into Wu Heixing’s eyes and spoke.
hunks.sol: I looked straight into Wu Heixing’s eyes.

hunks.baseline: “Sound Transmission. Right?”
hunks.sol: “That was Sound Transmission, wasn’t it?”

hunks.baseline: His face stiffened. That was answer enough. I had suspected as much, but I scratched the back of my head and muttered,
hunks.sol: His face stiffened. That was answer enough. I’d had my suspicions, but I still scratched the back of my head and muttered,

hunks.baseline: “So it was. Well, this is the mainland, after all. There could still be all kinds of martial arts here. An internal-energy cultivation technique, for example.”
hunks.sol: “So it was. Well, this is the mainland. I suppose all kinds of martial arts might have survived here. An internal-energy cultivation technique, for example.”

hunks.baseline: “W-what are you talking about? That was Message Spell…”
hunks.sol: “W-what are you talking about? That was a Message Spell…”

hunks.baseline: A quiet laugh escaped me at his frantic excuses.
hunks.sol: A dry laugh escaped me at the sight of his frantic excuses.

hunks.baseline: People who had never encountered martial arts might not be able to tell the difference, but he couldn’t fool me.
hunks.sol: Someone who had never encountered martial arts might not be able to tell the difference, but he couldn’t fool me.

hunks.baseline: The thing that had reached my ear near the end of the meeting had unmistakably been Sound Transmission.
hunks.sol: What had reached my ear near the end of the meeting had unmistakably been Sound Transmission.

hunks.baseline: The reason I had accepted an offer I could have ignored was because Wu Heixing himself had been the one to send it.
hunks.sol: The reason I had accepted an invitation I could easily have ignored was that Wu Heixing himself had sent it.

hunks.baseline: “H-how did you know that?”
hunks.sol: “H-how do you know about that?”

hunks.baseline: “What, was it a secret no one else knew?”
hunks.sol: “What, was it some secret no one else knew?”

hunks.baseline: “I did think it was somewhat possible, but it’s still fascinating. Didn’t you wipe out all the martial artists during your Cultural Revolution and whatnot? Martial arts somehow survived even through that.”
hunks.sol: “I knew it was possible, but it’s still fascinating. Didn’t you wipe out all your martial artists during the Cultural Revolution and whatnot? I’m impressed any martial arts survived.”

hunks.baseline: “Ah, you said your family was powerful. Did the highest levels of the Communist Party use their positions to quietly spirit it away?”
hunks.sol: “Ah, that’s right. You said your family was powerful. Did someone at the highest levels of the Communist Party use their position to quietly spirit them away?”

hunks.baseline: His expression instantly sank.
hunks.sol: His expression instantly went cold.

hunks.baseline: As a foreigner, I didn’t know exactly how serious a problem this was. But I knew how valuable an internal-energy cultivation technique was—the thing now called a mana cultivation method in the modern era.
hunks.sol: As a foreigner, I didn’t know exactly how serious an issue this was. But I did know the value of an internal-energy cultivation technique—the thing known in the modern era as a mana cultivation method.

hunks.baseline: *If this were the Murim, a bloody storm would have erupted.*
hunks.sol: *If this were Murim, it would have sparked a bloody storm.*

hunks.baseline: Now that he’d been caught with the golden calf that had been secretly spirited away, it was only natural that he’d react badly.
hunks.sol: He had been caught with the golden calf his family had secretly spirited away. No wonder he wasn’t taking it well.

hunks.baseline: “It would be best if you never uttered what you just said again.”
hunks.sol: “You would do well never to repeat what you just said.”

hunks.baseline: “I wasn’t planning to, but your tone is pretty damn irritating.”
hunks.sol: “I wasn’t planning to, but that tone of yours is pretty damn irritating.”

hunks.baseline: “Even after you find out who my father is, do you think you can keep acting like this?”
hunks.sol: “Do you think you’ll still be able to act this way once you learn who my father is?”

hunks.baseline: “Wasn’t your father the one who smashed Confucius’s tomb with a sledgehammer in his youth?”
hunks.sol: “Was your father the one who went around smashing Confucius’s tomb with a sledgehammer in his youth?”

hunks.baseline: “You fucking bangzi bastard—!”
hunks.sol: “You fucking *bangzi* bastard—!”

hunks.baseline: With an enraged roar, his body shot forward.
hunks.sol: With a furious roar, he shot forward.

hunks.baseline: A straight sword had already been drawn from its scabbard. The Aura Blade rising from it—no, the Sword Force—flew toward my neck.
hunks.sol: A straight sword flashed from its scabbard. The Aura Blade rising from it—no, the Sword Force—slashed toward my neck.

hunks.baseline: The rush of wind scattered my hair. I bent backward until my back nearly touched the ground, avoiding the Sword Force, then sprang upright and drove my knee into his chin.
hunks.sol: The rush of wind scattered my hair. I bent backward until my waist nearly touched the ground, letting the Sword Force pass overhead, then sprang upright and drove my knee into his chin.

hunks.baseline: Teeth and blood shot into the air. As he staggered, I seized both his arms and whispered into his ear.
hunks.sol: Teeth and blood sprayed into the air. As he staggered, I seized both his arms and whispered into his ear.

hunks.baseline: Hiss, crack!
hunks.sol: Hiss! Crack!

hunks.baseline: The powerful Scorching Yang Qi surging through both my hands shattered his armor and seared his flesh.
hunks.sol: The powerful Scorching Yang Qi surging through my hands shattered his armor and seared his flesh.

hunks.baseline: His scream could not travel beyond the Qi Curtain I had spread.
hunks.sol: The scream that tore from Wu Heixing’s lips struck the Qi Curtain I had spread and went no farther.

hunks.baseline: That bastard had learned fist-and-foot techniques too. Unlike his shoddy sword technique, this one had some bite.
hunks.sol: This bastard had learned unarmed combat too. Unlike his shoddy sword technique, this was reasonably sharp.

hunks.baseline: *Compared with the Murim, the quality of his martial arts was far lower.*
hunks.sol: *Compared with Murim, the quality of his martial arts was far lower.*

hunks.baseline: The leg he had whipped toward my waist like a lash could go no farther.
hunks.sol: The leg he had whipped toward my waist like a lash stopped dead.

hunks.baseline: “Well.”
hunks.sol: “I’m good.”

hunks.baseline: I grabbed his ankle and slammed him into the ground with all my strength.
hunks.sol: I seized his ankle and slammed him into the ground with all my strength.

hunks.baseline: More. More, more, more.
hunks.sol: Again. Again and again.

hunks.baseline: The ground turned over, and rocks and trees were ripped from the earth.
hunks.sol: The ground churned, and rocks and trees were ripped from the earth.

hunks.baseline: A little while later, when I finally stopped using him as a living pickaxe, Wu Heixing lay spread-eagled in a huge crater, looking as if his soul had left his body.
hunks.sol: By the time I stopped using him as a living pickaxe, Wu Heixing lay spread-eagled in a massive crater, looking as though his soul had left his body.

hunks.baseline: “Still, you’ve got a sturdy body. You’re not hurt that badly.”
hunks.sol: “You’re pretty sturdy, at least. You barely got hurt.”

hunks.baseline: “Hhaa…”
hunks.sol: “Hhaaa…”

hunks.baseline: Clicking my tongue, I bent over and searched through his pockets.
hunks.sol: Clicking my tongue, I bent over and searched his pockets.

hunks.baseline: After rummaging through the pouch with spatial expansion magic for a while, I finally found what I wanted.
hunks.sol: After rummaging through the pouch enchanted with spatial expansion magic for some time, I finally found what I wanted.

hunks.baseline:
> **System**
> **Acquired:** Supreme Potion!
hunks.sol:
> **System**
>
> **Acquired:** Supreme Potion!

hunks.baseline: “...No, wait. Supreme Potion? What the hell, you bastard?”
hunks.sol: “…Wait. Supreme Potion? What the hell, you bastard?”

hunks.baseline: I stared at the sprawled-out Wu Heixing in shock. Even if he was an S-rank Hunter, who carried something like this around?
hunks.sol: I stared in shock at the sprawled-out Wu Heixing. Even for an S-rank Hunter, who carried something like this around?

hunks.baseline: Advanced Potions were rare, but Supreme Potions were items of which only one or two appeared in an entire year, if that.
hunks.sol: Advanced Potions were rare enough, but only one or two Supreme Potions appeared in an entire year, if that.

hunks.baseline: Putting aside the price, which didn’t even feel real, they were so scarce that they couldn’t be obtained even with money.
hunks.sol: Never mind the price, which was so high it hardly felt real. They were so scarce that even having the money wasn’t enough to get one.

hunks.baseline: *I’d only ever seen one online. And now here it is.*
hunks.sol: *I’d only ever seen these online. And now I find one here.*

hunks.baseline: After a moment of thought, I quietly slipped the Supreme Potion into my inventory. Then I searched through his pouch again, found an Advanced Potion, and poured it over him.
hunks.sol: After a moment’s thought, I quietly slipped the Supreme Potion into my inventory. Then I searched his pouch again, found an Advanced Potion, and poured it over him.

hunks.baseline: “I’ve taken my settlement payment, so I’ll let you off here. You’ve got plenty to hide, so if you go blabbing about what happened today… you know what happens, right?”
hunks.sol: “I’ve taken my settlement payment, so I’ll let you off here. You’ve got plenty to hide yourself, so if you go around blabbing about what happened today… you know what’ll happen, right?”

hunks.baseline: Just as I had neatly wrapped things up, the phone in my pocket began to vibrate.
hunks.sol: Just as I neatly wrapped things up, the phone in my pocket shuddered.

hunks.baseline: I had received one short text message from Team Leader Choi.
hunks.sol: A short text message had arrived from Team Leader Choi.

hunks.baseline:
> 〈 Team Leader Choi
>
> Team Leader Choi
>
> Ji[n] Taekyung, please come qui[c]kly.
hunks.sol:

>
> Team Leader Choi
>
